_about: The shared kit's numbers, the same in every mode.

levels._about: What a level means everywhere. count: how many levels there are; every list below has one entry a level (check step 1). decoys: things on offer nobody asked for. lookalike: one decoy looks like a wanted thing. hintS: seconds without a right move before help comes. cardEnglish, cardPicture: whether the order card shows them or hides them behind a tap. dishCard: the dish's own card is shown as the headline is said. wordAtTap: a thing's word is said as it goes in. countAloud, countAsWords: counting is said, and shown as number words (else dots).

help._about: showTheWayAt: a dish wrong this many times is shown the right way. noHelpFromStage: no stuck help for an asked-for word once the child's ladder has it at this stage.

lines._about: The lines every mode says, as meanings for the language engine.

wordArt._about: A word's own picture, the same on the shelf, on its card and in the helper. size: the shelf's size class (L, M, S).

art._about: The kit's own pictures, by art id.

timings._about: How long the page waits for what it needs. pictureWaitMs: the longest a scene, or a move showing a picture, waits for that picture before it goes on without it (old chai's cap on a station's load, js/cook/station-lib.js:755).

look._about: The look's numbers. vars: fed to the one style sheet (css/kit.css) as variables, so no size or colour is typed there. turn-disc: the turn-your-phone card's disc; start, start-phone: the first-tap play button on a laptop and on a phone. item-*: the order row's item card, a share of its row (cqi: of the row for its padding, of the card inside it), as the standard measured; tick: its corner mark; no-sign, no-inset: a "no" card's sign in its picture's top right corner, and how far in, as shares of the picture's width (Zafar, 18 Nov: 'in the upper right corner ... but bigger than the old version': old chai's is 17.2 px on a 64 px picture at his phone, old css/shared/order-card.css:599; 0.54 is about twice it, option B of three he picks from); no-pic: the picture under it, nearly whole so the thing shows; helper-*: Nani's helper card; big-*: the big card's insides, as shares of its width; tap: a full tap; panel-fade: the order list's soft foot; speaker-min, speaker-phone: a speaker's least drawn size, and its share on a phone. end-ground: the plain ground under the end card's dim, so nothing of the round shows round the card (the standard's end). wordFont, wordWeight: the words drawn in the play area (the shelf's pills, a word's pop): drawn sharp, so a step heavier than the standard's 600, which its blurrier drawing showed this heavy (measured side by side, 18 Nov). solidAlpha: a pixel this opaque (of 255) is part of a picture's own outline (stage.solid). The order panel's vars: nani-* her box (two lines' room and a hairline, nani-hair, as the standard's, nani-font-lift her line's size as the panel shrinks), cards-* the list, head-* a card's top line, fold-* a card folding and its tick, helper-*-ms her helper sliding, row-fade the row's edge fade; pop-* the big card's defaults; wm-* the word moment's card (shares of its width, old chai's measured at 1280x665 and 950x290: picture 56.25% tall, its art 6% in, the Kutchi 15% wide 4% under it, the English 7.4% (never under item-en) 3.5% under that, the divider 74.8% wide, 1.5 px, and the speaker 25% (never under a tap) 7% either side, no ring: old css/shared/word-moment.css:66-76), its frame (corners 22% of it closing in from 30% further out, a 2 px white line with a soft shade, its flash fading over 420 ms: old word-moment.css:32-49) and the glass's lip laid over the stream (rows 3 to 5% of the glass: old :29-30); speaker-pulse-*: a speaker lit while its word is said (old css/shared/word-card.css:124-125); count-* the count pills; tail-* the bubble's tail. badge-*: the speaker badge on a face, all of it a share of the face it is on, so it is the same on every face at every size (Zafar, 18 Nov: 'make it scale with the face it's on'): badge-of-face its size, 0.40, between old chai's 16 on a 48 face and the 0.46 he had on his phone (Zafar, 18 Nov: 'somewhere between the old and current size'; old css/shared/face.css:40 draws 0.38 with a 16 px floor); badge-x, badge-hang its place (left of the face's box as the standard's 2 px on a 44 px face, and just below it: less than the standard's 3 px, so it stays clear of the item cards below: Zafar, 18 Nov); badge-ring its outline, thinner than the standard's 2 px (Zafar, 18 Nov: 'maybe reducing the outline around it will help'); bubble-line: the bubble's edge.

halo._about: The gold halo behind a lit thing: its colour, how far it spreads (design px), how many copies make it soft and on which rings (shares of the spread), each copy's strength, and its breathing (to this alpha, this long each way).

speakerMark._about: The flat speaker on a pill, in design px from its left edge: the box, the cone, and its two waves.

textures._about: The sizes of pictures the stage makes itself, in px: a face badge, a soft shadow, a halo's small copy; the badge's hairline; solid: the small copy a picture's solid outline is read from; outline: the working copy a flat thing's own-shape shadow and dimming are drawn from.

boxShadow._about: The soft shadow of a flat thing on the worktop (the hob, the serving tray), in its own shape (its picture blurred), from the same light as the standing things' shadows: moved right and down by dx, dy and blurred by blur, all shares of the thing's shorter side; alpha: its strength; padOfBlur: the room kept round it for the blur, in blurs.

frame._about: How the page fits the screen it has, live (js/shared/frame.js). formFactors: by shape, not size: a phone's short side is under phone.shortBelow; a tablet or folding phone's is at least tablet.shortFrom and it is no wider than tablet.aspectUpTo; anything else is a laptop. scale: one number per screen, clamp(min, short side / refShort, max); it grows the side panel and the page's own buttons. side: the side panel's width, clamp(min x scale, share x width, max x scale). panel: the panel's own scale (--p) on each form factor. fit: while the panel's content would not fit, its scale steps down by step, never below minScale times its own. turnBelowWidth: an upright screen narrower than this gets the turn-your-phone card. settleMs: a turn is laid out again once it has settled. fonts, fontsWaitMs: the faces waited for before anything is drawn, at most this long.

voice._about: The family's voices, played through the page's sound (js/core/voice-player.js). gain: how loud, against the file. trim: the silence a recording left at either end is cut: the first and last sound are where the level passes floorShare of the clip's peak (never under floorMin), with leadS before and tailS after kept, and a clip whose sound is shorter than minS plays whole. endPadMs: a clip always ends by its length plus this, whatever the browser does. loadMs: a clip's download and decode give up after this long (it is tried again the next time). clockMs: how often a clip's own clock is looked at. wordGapMs: the pause between two words of a line said word by word, as old chai has it: old js/core/voice.js:472 waits 40 ms, then old js/cook/core.js:286-293 and :339-341 fetch and decode the next clip only when it is due, so its words came 0.44 to 0.62 s apart (measured end to start in old chai, level 1, 8 joins over 3 plays; mean 0.53 s). Mum's whole takes have no such pause.

device._about: The device's own voice, for a word with no family recording, on the test path only (js/core/voice.js deviceSpeak); every number old chai's (old js/core/voice.js:315-421). rate: its speed. cancelGapMs: after a cancel the browser drops a word spoken in the same breath, so the next waits this long (old :317). voicesWaitMs, voicesPollMs: a phone's Chrome loads its voices lazily; wait this long at most from the first ask, looking this often (old :343, :372). noStartMs, noVoiceMs: a word that has not started by then is let go of and cancelled (with voices, and with none installed: old :414). capMs + capPerLetterMs x its letters: the longest a word may speak (old :415). dueEveryMs: how often a word that speaks looks whether its line is still wanted (new: old chai had no late cancel).

cards._about: The order cards' timings, in milliseconds. foldAfterMs: a served card holds its ticks this long, then folds. peekMs: how long a tapped-open part stays open. dotsMin, dotsMax: a hidden word's dots, one fewer than its letters, between these. lessonBeatMs, lessonEndMs: the first-time lesson's beat after each part and after the last; lessonCardMs: its light round the whole card first, then gliding to each part in lessonMoveMs; lessonMargin: its light's margin; lessonMinPx: a part smaller than this is not asked for.

sounds._about: The sound effects, by name. files: recorded sounds (loop: played round and round; cut: only its first part, in ms). synth: sounds made of notes, each [wave, from Hz, to Hz, ms, loudness, starts at ms]; noise: [ms, band Hz, sharpness, loudness, starts at ms]. under: how loud a sound the child made plays under a voice; tick: a short tick under a voice; master: the made sounds' overall loudness. simmer: the boil's loudness in dB at heat 0, at the bubbling, and at boiling over.

ramp._about: The sound player's own ramps, in seconds: floor: the quietest a fade reaches; attack, noiseAttack: a note's and a hiss's rise; tail: a note's stop after its end; loopFade, loopStop: a loop ending; duck, simmerDuck: how fast a loop goes under a voice.

order._about: The order's timings, in milliseconds. pop: a big card appearing. fly: its flight into its slot, flyEase its easing (one even scale, centre to centre). partGap: between parts. cardOpen: a card opening. passAfter: before the next person. holdAlong: the beat after the last part. walkIn: people arriving, then walkWait before anyone speaks. dishCardOut: the dish's own card fading where it stands. bigW: the big card's widest, with its width's share of the play area's width (bigOfW) and height (bigWOfH); bigMaxOfH: never taller than this share of the play area's height (Zafar, 17 Nov, his red box), its width from the row card's shape (bigShape, height over width, if the row card cannot be measured). bigAt: the big card's corner beside the side panel. bigByPeople: the big card's place and size by how many people order. bigHeadGap: it never touches a head. bubbleGap: a bubble keeps this far off the big card. bubbleShift: the big card shrinks until the speaker's bubble need move aside by no more than this share of its own width. rowSlideMs, rowSlideEase: an order card's row, its cards sliding to their new places as one ticks (old js/shared/order-card.js:497); rowGlideAfterMs: then the row glides to its rest (old :534). focusPeek: a person's card brought into the panel's view shows at least this much of its top, the list scrolled no further. rowFadeRun: an order card's row fades at an edge while there is more to swipe that way, fully once this many px are left (its width: look.vars row-fade).

panel._about: The side panel's list of order cards (js/shared/kit/order-panel.js). It rests at its top or this many px above a card's top (edge, and at least edgeKeep px less than the gap between cards, so the card above is wholly out of view); it is measured once nothing in it has moved for quietMs and every card's fold and the helper's slide have ended (their times are look.vars fold-ms, helper-open-ms, helper-shut-ms), then glides there in glideMs. settleMs: its longest move, from a change to resting (a card's fold, quietMs, then the glide: the panel checks it is at least those), which the kitchen's rules wait out before lighting a card. A big card waits for it at most stillCapMs before it flies.

room._about: The kitchen with its people, in design px. picture: where the tall painting's top-left sits. spots: where people stand, by x. counterY: the counter's back edge, which hides everything below it. lift: how much higher the order is framed, by how many people. from: where people walk in from. naniX: where Nani stands at the serve. serveGlide: how far the view glides down to the trays. tray: one serving tray per person and the dish landing on it. bubbleGap: the gap between a bubble and the top of the highest head's outline (its tail in that gap); talk: a speaker's talking picture flaps (open, then shut for a time between two numbers) with a small bob; at the thanks, afterMs: the beat a person rests in their happy pose, the bubble gone, before the next line. serveWait: the pause before the kitchen comes back. serveSpread: with three people they stand evenly from this far right of Nani to this far inside the right edge. tray.gapShare: a tray is at most this share of the gap between two people; tray.inside: kept this far inside the view; tray.shade: its shadow's width beside its own; tray.faceAt: the face mark's place on its rim; tray.keepBelow: the serve keeps this much below the trays' shadows in view. pictureH, pictureW: the painting's height and width (a room shown smaller to keep the serve's heads and trays whole never shows past its sides). needW: on a play area taller than the painting allows, the room is shown bigger, cropped at its sides, never narrower than this (everyone at the counter stays in view). speech: the speech strip every scene with people keeps above the highest head (Zafar, 18 Nov): one bubble's height, by kind (greet: the door's and the order's room, the tallest; line: the serve's) and form factor, in CSS px at the screen's scale, with bubbleGap below it and bubbleMin above; a bubble always sits in it over its speaker, and where the frame cannot give it the people stand lower. tailMin: the tail stays this far in from the bubble's ends, clear of its rounded corners, so no corner of it shows. sideKeep: screen px every head, and at the serve every tray, keeps inside the slice of the room the screen shows (people are spread across that slice).

wordMoment._about: The word moment's frame, shutter and card, sizes and times (ms) the old game's (old js/shared/word-moment.js, played at speed 0.75: old js/cook/ui.js:166, so each of its times is divided by 0.75 here). What shows each word is the family's act (the kitchen's pour: data/kitchen.json pourMoment). frame: the snap's frame round the shown thing, in its sizes (old :469). cardOfThing: the word card's width, in the shown thing's size before its room shrank it (old :520, 1.25 of the glass), never wider than its share of the room less cardRoom px (old :520), shrunk at most cardFits times until it fits the room's height, never under cardLeast px (old :527-530); cardKeep: px it keeps inside the scene (old :531). cardGrowFrom, cardGrowMs, cardGrowEase: the card grows from the thing's size, from this opacity (old :534). lookMs: once shown, a look at all of them before the first snap (old :566-567: 450 and 900 at speed 0.75, less the kettle's going); cornersInMs: the corners start to close (old :480); cornersMs: the corners before the shutter (old :480-484, frameHold 500); shutterMs: the flash before the card (old :506); sayAfterMs: the card before its word (old :543); holdMs: after the word; lingerMs: the cards stay; fadeMs: the scene going (old js/cook/ui.js:172-174).

greetings._about: The greeting's lines: each a meaning for the language engine, and the small picture that goes with an answer.

ladder._about: The word ladder: a word's stage climbs one for every so many rounds it was right first time, up to the top stage. pillRun: a word picked right this many times running loses its written word on the shelf pill (a miss brings it back until the next right pick).

light._about: The light's box: a margin round the thing (a share of its smaller side, between two sizes in px) and its corner. followMs: after anything on the page moves, the light follows its thing this long.

cog._about: The cog's menu, top right of the play area: what each button is for.

greeting._about: The greeting's numbers. idleMs: with no answer for this long the person says it for the child. lightAfterWrongs: the right answer is lit after this many wrong tries. rightFirst: how often the right answer is the left one. afterClipMs: the answers rise this long after the line. wrongPauseMs: before the person asks again. afterReplyMs, fadeMs: the close. silentBase, silentPerLetter: how long a line with no recording is held. passGlyph: the pass button's mark.

end._about: The end screen's numbers. nearBest: a time within this many times the best keeps a dim gold watch. midShare: this share of rows right is the middle tier. shortSecs: under this a time shows as seconds and counts up. popMs: a tile's contents pop in. countSteps, countMs: the time counts up. waits: after each tile, in ms. tickSteps, tickMs, tickVolume: the rows count up, a tick on each. pageMs: the card eases to the second page. wordCols: word tiles across. tightOver, smallFrom: more words than this on a side sit tighter, then smaller. stars: where the six stars twinkle on a tile, each [left %, top %, delay s]. listKinds: the kinds of word the second page lists (things and numbers; never a connective, a 'no' or a verb).

serving._about: The serving spot's small numbers (sizes in design px unless a share). face: a person's mark on the spot (its biggest, smallest, and size in screen px), kept this far from the spot's corner (pad), slid in at most (slide) to clear its dish by (clear). settle: a dish's small settle, as scales and times. undimMs: the spot coming out of its dim. drop: the painted drop (where it starts and lands and its width, in dish-widths; its fade and fall). twinkle: the three twinkles (small and big: their span and middle in dish-widths; each one's place and size in the span; the gap between them; grow from, turn, and times). review: the big faces (size with one dish; with more, between two sizes as a share of the gap between dishes; how far from the dish; kept inside the spot; pop from, pop time; a happy face's two small hops and a sad one's shake). praise: the white card by a face (gap, text inset, height, radius, lift, font, shadow, fade). closeMs, closeTo: the faces going. veil: the colour the tray is dimmed in while the cooking goes on (the game's dim says how much).

shelf._about: The bottom row's small numbers (design px unless a share). far: how far the band runs past the sheet's sides. band: its tile's scale and strength, the line along its top, the shelf tile's scale. fit: a thing is kept this much narrower than its slot. shade: a thing's shadow (lift, width as a share, height). pillPop: a tapped pill's pop. pillRadius, pillDrop: a pill's corner and its shadow's drop. squash: a thing taken or put back squashes and springs. spoon: the spoon (its start above the thing, its handle point, its angles at rest, over the pan and tipping; the last part of its stir, where it lifts and fades; its tip and going times). popRadius, popDrop: the word pop's corner and shadow.

lineTimes._about: Small waits round Nani's lines, in ms. wellDoneAfter: the praise comes this long after the faces pop; wellDoneCap: the longest it waits for her voice; wellDoneHold: the beat after it. wrongRowCap: the longest a wrong order's row waits for its voice; wrongRowGap: between rows.
